title: Name from "bulak"
description: Bulakan takes its name from the Tagalog word for cotton. Early accounts note cotton growing widely in the area when the Spanish arrived.

title: First capital of Bulacan
description: Before Malolos, Bulakan was the provincial capital and a trade hub with Manila through its rivers and coastline.

title: Marcelo H. del Pilar
description: The NHCP Museo ni Marcelo H. del Pilar in San Nicolas honors Plaridel, editor of La Solidaridad and a key Propaganda Movement figure.

title: Fourteen barangays
description: From Bagumbayan to Tibig, including coastal Taliptip — local government starts at the barangay hall and the municipal offices in San Jose (Poblacion).
